content.json:
# Ghost NIC Hunter

**Latest maintenance state per VM.** `CleanupPending` means ghost NICs were detected but remain; `RebootPending` means cleanup succeeded and Windows should be restarted; `OfflineSkipped` means all retry checks found the VM offline. Data can arrive a few minutes after the Automation job completes.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true AzureDiagnostics, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, ResourceProvider:string, Category:string, StreamType_s:string, RunbookName_s:string, ResultDescription:string)[])
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION' and Category == 'JobStreams' and StreamType_s == 'Output' and RunbookName_s == 'Invoke-GhostNicMaintenance'
| extend raw = tostring(ResultDescription)
| where raw startswith 'GHNIC_RESULT:'
| extend event = parse_json(substring(raw, strlen('GHNIC_RESULT:')))
| extend VmResourceId = tostring(event.VmResourceId), Operation = tostring(event.Operation), Outcome = tostring(event.Outcome), ReportedState = tostring(event.MaintenanceState), GhostedCount = toint(event.GhostedCount), RemovedCount = toint(event.RemovedCount), RemainingCount = toint(event.RemainingCount), RestartRequired = tobool(event.RestartRequired)
| where isnotempty(VmResourceId)
| extend PendingGhosts = case(isnotnull(RemainingCount), RemainingCount, Operation == 'Remove' and isnotnull(RemovedCount), iff(GhostedCount > RemovedCount, GhostedCount - RemovedCount, 0), GhostedCount)
| extend MaintenanceState = case(isnotempty(ReportedState), ReportedState, Outcome == 'OfflineSkipped', 'OfflineSkipped', Outcome in ('SafetyAbort', 'PartialFailure', 'RunCommandFailed', 'RestartFailed'), 'AttentionRequired', Operation == 'Remove' and RemovedCount > 0 and RestartRequired, 'RebootPending', PendingGhosts > 0, 'CleanupPending', isnotnull(GhostedCount), 'VerifiedClean', 'AttentionRequired')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, PendingGhosts, MaintenanceState) by VmResourceId
| summarize CurrentGhostNics = sum(PendingGhosts), CleanupPending = countif(MaintenanceState == 'CleanupPending'), RebootPending = countif(MaintenanceState in ('RebootPending', 'RestartInitiated')), OfflineSkipped = countif(MaintenanceState == 'OfflineSkipped'), AttentionRequired = countif(MaintenanceState in ('AttentionRequired', 'RebootFailed')), VerifiedClean = countif(MaintenanceState == 'VerifiedClean')
| project Metrics = pack_array(pack('Metric', 'Current ghost NICs', 'Value', CurrentGhostNics), pack('Metric', 'Cleanup pending', 'Value', CleanupPending), pack('Metric', 'Reboot pending', 'Value', RebootPending), pack('Metric', 'Offline skipped', 'Value', OfflineSkipped), pack('Metric', 'Attention required', 'Value', AttentionRequired), pack('Metric', 'Verified clean', 'Value', VerifiedClean))
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Value = tolong(Metrics.Value)

union isfuzzy=true AzureDiagnostics, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, ResourceProvider:string, Category:string, StreamType_s:string, RunbookName_s:string, ResultDescription:string)[])
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION' and Category == 'JobStreams' and StreamType_s == 'Output' and RunbookName_s == 'Invoke-GhostNicMaintenance'
| extend raw = tostring(ResultDescription)
| where raw startswith 'GHNIC_RESULT:'
| extend event = parse_json(substring(raw, strlen('GHNIC_RESULT:')))
| extend VmResourceId = tostring(event.VmResourceId), Operation = tostring(event.Operation), GhostedCount = toint(event.GhostedCount), RemovedCount = toint(event.RemovedCount), Outcome = tostring(event.Outcome)
| where Operation == 'Remove' and isnotnull(RemovedCount)
| summarize RemovalJobs = count(), GhostCandidates = sum(GhostedCount), GhostNicsRemoved = sum(RemovedCount), VmsRemediated = dcountif(VmResourceId, RemovedCount > 0), SafetyAborts = countif(Outcome == 'SafetyAbort')
| project Metrics = pack_array(pack('Metric', 'Removal jobs reported', 'Value', RemovalJobs), pack('Metric', 'Ghost NICs presented', 'Value', GhostCandidates), pack('Metric', 'Ghost NICs removed', 'Value', GhostNicsRemoved), pack('Metric', 'VMs with removals', 'Value', VmsRemediated), pack('Metric', 'Safety aborts', 'Value', SafetyAborts))
| mv-expand Metrics
| project Metric = tostring(Metrics.Metric), Value = tolong(Metrics.Value)

Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| extend VmKey = tolower(id), PowerStateCode = tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code)
| extend LiveVmStatus = iff(PowerStateCode startswith 'PowerState/', strcat('VM ', substring(PowerStateCode, strlen('PowerState/'))), 'Unknown')
| project VmKey, LiveVmStatus

content.json:
## Fleet maintenance state

One row per VM from its newest structured result. **VM status** is refreshed live from Azure Resource Graph; the maintenance state comes from the latest Automation result.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true AzureDiagnostics, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, ResourceProvider:string, Category:string, StreamType_s:string, RunbookName_s:string, ResultDescription:string)[])
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION' and Category == 'JobStreams' and StreamType_s == 'Output' and RunbookName_s == 'Invoke-GhostNicMaintenance'
| extend raw = tostring(ResultDescription)
| where raw startswith 'GHNIC_RESULT:'
| extend event = parse_json(substring(raw, strlen('GHNIC_RESULT:')))
| extend VmResourceId = tostring(event.VmResourceId), Operation = tostring(event.Operation), Outcome = tostring(event.Outcome), ReportedState = tostring(event.MaintenanceState), PowerState = tostring(event.PowerState), GhostedCount = toint(event.GhostedCount), RemovedCount = toint(event.RemovedCount), RemainingCount = toint(event.RemainingCount), RestartRequired = tobool(event.RestartRequired), DetectedAtUtc = todatetime(event.DetectedAtUtc)
| where isnotempty(VmResourceId)
| extend PendingGhosts = case(isnotnull(RemainingCount), RemainingCount, Operation == 'Remove' and isnotnull(RemovedCount), iff(GhostedCount > RemovedCount, GhostedCount - RemovedCount, 0), GhostedCount)
| extend MaintenanceState = case(isnotempty(ReportedState), ReportedState, Outcome == 'OfflineSkipped', 'OfflineSkipped', Outcome in ('SafetyAbort', 'PartialFailure', 'RunCommandFailed', 'RestartFailed'), 'AttentionRequired', Operation == 'Remove' and RemovedCount > 0 and RestartRequired, 'RebootPending', PendingGhosts > 0, 'CleanupPending', isnotnull(GhostedCount), 'VerifiedClean', 'AttentionRequired')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by VmResourceId
| extend VmKey = tolower(VmResourceId), LastResultUtc = coalesce(DetectedAtUtc, TimeGenerated)
| order by MaintenanceState asc, PendingGhosts desc, LastResultUtc asc
| project VmKey, VM = VmResourceId, LastRunVmStatus = PowerState, MaintenanceState, Operation, Outcome, PendingGhosts, RemovedCount, RestartRequired, LastResultUtc

content.json:
## Current top offenders

Newest structured result with ghost counts, adjusted for removals reported by that result. **VM status** is read from Azure Resource Graph when the workbook refreshes; **Last-run status** is retained as a fallback.

content.query:
let events = union isfuzzy=true AzureDiagnostics, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, ResourceProvider:string, Category:string, StreamType_s:string, RunbookName_s:string, ResultDescription:string)[])
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION' and Category == 'JobStreams' and StreamType_s == 'Output' and RunbookName_s == 'Invoke-GhostNicMaintenance'
| extend raw = tostring(ResultDescription)
| where raw startswith 'GHNIC_RESULT:'
| extend event = parse_json(substring(raw, strlen('GHNIC_RESULT:')))
| extend VmResourceId = tostring(event.VmResourceId), Succeeded = tobool(event.Succeeded), Operation = tostring(event.Operation), GhostedCount = toint(event.GhostedCount), RemovedCount = toint(event.RemovedCount), RemainingCount = toint(event.RemainingCount), ValidCount = toint(event.ValidCount), LastScanUtc = todatetime(event.DetectedAtUtc), PowerState = tostring(event.PowerState);
let latestStatus = events
| extend LastRunVmStatus = iff(isnotempty(PowerState), PowerState, iff(Succeeded and isnotnull(GhostedCount), 'VM running', ''))
| where isnotempty(LastRunVmStatus)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, LastRunVmStatus) by VmResourceId
| project VmResourceId, LastRunVmStatus;
events
| where isnotnull(GhostedCount)
| extend PendingGhosts = case(isnotnull(RemainingCount), RemainingCount, Operation == 'Remove' and isnotnull(RemovedCount), iff(GhostedCount > RemovedCount, GhostedCount - RemovedCount, 0), GhostedCount)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, PendingGhosts, ValidCount, LastScanUtc) by VmResourceId
| where PendingGhosts > 0
| join kind=leftouter latestStatus on VmResourceId
| extend VmKey = tolower(VmResourceId), LastRunVmStatus = coalesce(LastRunVmStatus, 'Not recorded')
| order by PendingGhosts desc, LastScanUtc asc
| project VmKey, VM = VmResourceId, LastRunVmStatus, GhostNicsNow = PendingGhosts, ValidNics = ValidCount, LastScanUTC = LastScanUtc

content.json:
## History and remediation

Repeated findings indicate recurrence; cleaned VMs remain in history. Reported removals are counted from structured results even when final safety validation returns **SafetyAbort** or **PartialFailure**. **VM status** is refreshed from Azure Resource Graph; **Last-run status** remains visible for deleted or inaccessible VMs.

content.query:
let events = union isfuzzy=true AzureDiagnostics, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, ResourceProvider:string, Category:string, StreamType_s:string, RunbookName_s:string, ResultDescription:string)[])
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION' and Category == 'JobStreams' and StreamType_s == 'Output' and RunbookName_s == 'Invoke-GhostNicMaintenance'
| extend raw = tostring(ResultDescription)
| where raw startswith 'GHNIC_RESULT:'
| extend event = parse_json(substring(raw, strlen('GHNIC_RESULT:')))
| extend VmResourceId = tostring(event.VmResourceId), Succeeded = tobool(event.Succeeded), GhostedCount = toint(event.GhostedCount), RemovedCount = toint(event.RemovedCount), Operation = tostring(event.Operation), Outcome = tostring(event.Outcome), PowerState = tostring(event.PowerState);
let latestStatus = events
| extend LastRunVmStatus = iff(isnotempty(PowerState), PowerState, iff(Succeeded and isnotnull(GhostedCount), 'VM running', ''))
| where isnotempty(LastRunVmStatus)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, LastRunVmStatus) by VmResourceId
| project VmResourceId, LastRunVmStatus;
events
| where isnotnull(GhostedCount)
| summarize CumulativeGhosts = sum(GhostedCount), ScansWithGhosts = countif(GhostedCount > 0), GhostNicsRemoved = sum(RemovedCount), RemovalJobs = countif(Operation == 'Remove' and isnotnull(RemovedCount)), SafetyAborts = countif(Operation == 'Remove' and Outcome == 'SafetyAbort') by VmResourceId
| join kind=leftouter latestStatus on VmResourceId
| extend VmKey = tolower(VmResourceId), LastRunVmStatus = coalesce(LastRunVmStatus, 'Not recorded')
| order by CumulativeGhosts desc, ScansWithGhosts desc
| project VmKey, VM = VmResourceId, LastRunVmStatus, CumulativeGhosts, ScansWithGhosts, GhostNicsRemoved, RemovalJobs, SafetyAborts

union isfuzzy=true AzureDiagnostics, (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, ResourceProvider:string, Category:string, StreamType_s:string, RunbookName_s:string, ResultDescription:string)[])
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION' and Category == 'JobStreams' and StreamType_s == 'Output' and RunbookName_s == 'Invoke-GhostNicMaintenance'
| extend raw = tostring(ResultDescription)
| where raw startswith 'GHNIC_RESULT:'
| extend event = parse_json(substring(raw, strlen('GHNIC_RESULT:')))
| extend Operation = tostring(event.Operation), RemovedCount = toint(event.RemovedCount)
| where Operation == 'Remove' and isnotnull(RemovedCount)
| union (print TimeGenerated = ago(1s), RemovedCount = toint(0))
| make-series ['Ghost NICs removed'] = sum(RemovedCount) default = 0 on TimeGenerated from ago(30d) to now() step 7d
| mv-expand TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime), ['Ghost NICs removed'] to typeof(long)
| render timechart
